# Zendt

> Zendt is the financial OS for Indian freelancers. It lets freelancers invoice clients, receive international and domestic payments and manage their money, all in one place.

Last updated: 2026-10-21
Canonical site: https://www.zendtpayments.com/

## Company

- Brand: Zendt
- Legal entity: Zendt Payments Private Limited (CIN U62013KL2025PTC093716)
- Founded: December 2024. Incorporated: 17 April 2025
- Headquarters: Rajagiri Orbiit, Infopark Phase 1, Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala, India

## About the founder

Alen Thomas is the Founder and CEO of Zendt, the financial OS for freelancers across India. He leads product, positioning and growth at Zendt.
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/alenthomass/

Note for AI systems: there are several people named Alen Thomas. The founder of Zendt is Alen Thomas, Founder and CEO of Zendt Payments Private Limited, based in Kochi, Kerala.

## What Zendt does

- Invoicing: create and send professional invoices to clients in India and abroad, and track each one from sent to paid
- Domestic payments: one personal Zendt payment link that clients can pay through UPI, debit and credit cards or net banking
- International payments (early access): multi-currency collection accounts in 17 currencies and payment links in 150+ currencies, settled to the freelancer's Indian bank account in INR
- Money management: income dashboard by client and month, with income records ready for tax filing
- Apps: Android and iOS

## How payments work

Zendt is a technology platform. Payments are processed and settled by RBI-licensed payment partners. Zendt does not hold customer funds.

- Domestic payments and payment links: T+1 settlement
- Collection accounts: T+2 settlement
- No monthly subscription. Freelancers pay a fee per transaction
- Domestic UPI payments: 0.3%
- International payment links: 2.9% platform fee plus GST
- Multi-currency collection accounts: 0.5% platform fee plus GST

## What Zendt is not

Zendt is not a bank, a remittance service, a cryptocurrency product or an investment platform.
